mockTests.title: Punjab Police Mock Test 2 — 2024 Pattern
mockTests.description: 20 questions based on 2024 exam shift analysis. Medium-High difficulty.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.q: Which article of the Indian Constitution deals with the Right to Constitutional Remedies?
questions.exp: Article 32 provides the Right to Constitutional Remedies — the right to move the Supreme Court for enforcement of Fundamental Rights. Dr. Ambedkar called it the 'Heart and Soul of the Constitution'.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.q: The Battle of Chamkaur (1704) was fought between Guru Gobind Singh and the forces of which Mughal Emperor?
questions.exp: The Battle of Chamkaur (21-22 December 1704) was fought between Guru Gobind Singh and the Mughal forces of Emperor Aurangzeb. Guru Gobind Singh's two elder sons (Sahibzadas) were martyred in this battle.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.q: Which river is known as the 'Sorrow of Punjab'?
questions.exp: The Ghaggar river, which was once a mighty river (believed to be the ancient Saraswati), is called the 'Sorrow of Punjab' because it frequently floods and causes damage in Punjab and Haryana during monsoons.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.q: The Headquarters of the Border Security Force (BSF) is located in:
questions.exp: The Headquarters of the Border Security Force (BSF) is located in New Delhi. BSF is India's primary border guarding force on the borders with Pakistan and Bangladesh.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.q: Which Punjab city is known as the 'Sports Capital of India'?
questions.exp: Jalandhar is known as the 'Sports Capital of India' because it is the largest manufacturer of sports goods in India, producing equipment used in international sports events including the Olympics.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.q: The Preamble of the Indian Constitution declares India to be a:
questions.exp: As amended by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment (1976), the Preamble declares India to be a Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic Republic. The words 'Socialist' and 'Secular' were added in 1976.

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.q: A shopkeeper sells an article at ₹840 making a profit of 20%. What was the cost price?

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.q: The average of 5 consecutive odd numbers is 45. What is the largest number?
questions.exp: If the average of 5 consecutive odd numbers is 45, then the middle number is 45. The numbers are 41, 43, 45, 47, 49. The largest number is 49.

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.q: A train 180 metres long passes a pole in 9 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/h?
questions.exp: Speed = Distance/Time = 180/9 = 20 m/s. Convert to km/h: 20 × 18/5 = 72 km/h.

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.q: If 8 men can complete a work in 15 days, how many days will 12 men take to complete the same work?
questions.exp: Using MDH formula: M1×D1 = M2×D2. 8×15 = 12×D2. D2 = 120/12 = 10 days.

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.q: Simple interest on ₹5000 at 8% per annum for 3 years is:

questions.subject: Mental Ability & Reasoning
questions.q: Find the missing number in the series: 3, 9, 27, 81, ___
questions.exp: Each number is multiplied by 3: 3×3=9, 9×3=27, 27×3=81, 81×3=243. The pattern is powers of 3.

questions.subject: Mental Ability & Reasoning
questions.q: If POLICE is coded as QPMJDF, then how is CRIME coded?
questions.exp: Each letter is shifted one position forward in the alphabet: C→D, R→S, I→J, M→N, E→F. So CRIME = DSJNF.

questions.subject: Mental Ability & Reasoning
questions.q: Pointing to a man, a woman said 'His mother is the only daughter of my mother.' How is the woman related to the man?
questions.exp: The only daughter of the woman's mother = the woman herself. So the man's mother is the woman herself. Therefore, the woman is the man's Mother.

questions.subject: Mental Ability & Reasoning
questions.q: In a row of students, Ravi is 8th from the left and 14th from the right. How many students are in the row?
questions.exp: Total students = Position from left + Position from right - 1 = 8 + 14 - 1 = 21 students.

questions.subject: Mental Ability & Reasoning
questions.q: If North-East becomes South and South-East becomes West, what does North become?
questions.exp: The directions are rotated 135° clockwise (NE→S is a 135° clockwise rotation). Applying same rotation: North rotated 135° clockwise = South-West.

questions.subject: English Language
questions.q: Choose the correct spelling:
questions.exp: The correct spelling is 'Accommodation' — double 'c' and double 'm'. A common mistake is writing only one 'c' or one 'm'.

questions.subject: English Language
questions.q: Select the synonym of 'DILIGENT':
questions.exp: Diligent means showing careful and persistent work effort. Its synonym is Hardworking. Antonym is Lazy or Indolent.

questions.subject: Digital Literacy
questions.q: Which keyboard shortcut is used to 'Save As' a document in MS Word?
questions.exp: F12 opens the 'Save As' dialog box in MS Word. Ctrl+S is used to Save (not Save As). F12 is one of the most commonly tested MS Office shortcuts in government exams.

questions.subject: Digital Literacy
questions.q: What does 'RAM' stand for in computers?
questions.exp: RAM stands for Random Access Memory. It is the primary memory of a computer that stores data temporarily while the computer is running. More RAM means faster performance.

mockTests.title: Punjab Police Mock Test 3 — Punjab Special Focus
mockTests.description: 20 questions with heavy Punjab GK focus. High difficulty — based on 2025 paper trends.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.q: Who was the first Chief Minister of Punjab after its reorganization in 1966?
questions.exp: Gurnam Singh became the first Chief Minister of Punjab after its reorganization on 1 November 1966 under the Punjab Reorganisation Act 1966, which created Punjab, Haryana, and Himachal Pradesh.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.q: The Anandpur Sahib Resolution (1973) was passed by which political party?
questions.exp: The Anandpur Sahib Resolution was passed by the Shiromani Akali Dal at Anandpur Sahib in 1973. It demanded greater autonomy for states and more rights for Punjab.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.q: Which is the largest district of Punjab by area?
questions.exp: Ferozepur is the largest district of Punjab by geographical area. It is also a strategically important border district sharing its boundary with Pakistan.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.q: The 'Operation Flood' in India is related to which sector?
questions.exp: Operation Flood (1970-1996) was the world's largest dairy development programme launched by NDDB (National Dairy Development Board) under Dr. Verghese Kurien. It made India the world's largest milk producer and is called the White Revolution.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.q: Bhagat Singh was born in which village of Punjab?
questions.exp: Bhagat Singh was born on 28 September 1907 in Banga village (now in Nawanshahr district, Punjab). His ancestral village was Khatkar Kalan where his memorial exists today.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.q: Which article of the Indian Constitution deals with Panchayati Raj institutions?
questions.exp: Article 243 (added by 73rd Constitutional Amendment, 1992) deals with Panchayati Raj institutions. It gave constitutional status to gram panchayats and mandated elections every 5 years.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.q: The Sirhind Canal, which irrigates most of Punjab, was built in:
questions.exp: The Sirhind Canal was constructed in 1882 during British rule. It is one of the oldest and longest canals in Punjab, originating from the Sutlej River at Rupar (Ropar) and irrigating large areas of Punjab, Haryana, and Rajasthan.

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.q: A number is increased by 25% and then decreased by 25%. What is the net percentage change?

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.q: The ratio of milk to water in a mixture is 4:1. If 5 litres of water is added, the ratio becomes 4:3. What was the initial quantity of milk?
questions.exp: Let milk = 4x, water = x. After adding 5L water: 4x/(x+5) = 4/3. 12x = 4x+20. 8x = 20. x = 2.5. Milk = 4×2.5 = 10 litres.

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.q: What is the compound interest on ₹8000 at 10% per annum for 2 years?

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.q: A boat travels 30 km upstream in 6 hours and 30 km downstream in 3 hours. What is the speed of the current?
questions.exp: Upstream speed = 30/6 = 5 km/h. Downstream speed = 30/3 = 10 km/h. Speed of current = (Downstream - Upstream)/2 = (10-5)/2 = 2.5 km/h.

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.q: Find the area of a triangle with base 12 cm and height 8 cm.
questions.exp: Area of triangle = ½ × base × height = ½ × 12 × 8 = 48 cm².

questions.subject: Mental Ability & Reasoning
questions.q: Complete the analogy: Doctor : Hospital :: Teacher : ?
questions.exp: A Doctor works in a Hospital. Similarly, a Teacher works in a School. This is a 'person and their workplace' analogy.

questions.subject: Mental Ability & Reasoning
questions.q: Find the odd one out: 17, 19, 23, 25, 29
questions.exp: 17, 19, 23, 29 are all prime numbers. 25 = 5×5 is not a prime number. So 25 is the odd one out.

questions.subject: Mental Ability & Reasoning
questions.q: If A is the brother of B, B is the sister of C, and C is the father of D, then how is A related to D?
questions.exp: A is brother of B → A is male. B is sister of C → B is female. C is father of D. A and C are siblings (both are B's siblings). Since A is male and uncle = father's brother, A is D's Uncle.

questions.subject: Mental Ability & Reasoning
questions.q: A clock shows 3:15. What is the angle between the hour and minute hands?

questions.subject: English Language
questions.q: Fill in the blank: She _____ in this city for ten years.
questions.exp: 'Has been living' is correct because the action started in the past and is still continuing (present perfect continuous). 'For ten years' signals a duration that continues to the present.

questions.subject: English Language
questions.q: Choose the antonym of 'COURAGEOUS':
questions.exp: The antonym (opposite) of Courageous (brave, fearless) is Cowardly (lacking courage, timid). Brave, Bold, and Fearless are all synonyms of Courageous.

questions.subject: Digital Literacy
questions.q: Which of the following is NOT an example of an Input device?
questions.exp: Monitor is an Output device — it displays information. Keyboard, Mouse, and Scanner are all Input devices that send data into the computer.

questions.subject: Digital Literacy
questions.q: The full form of 'URL' is:
questions.exp: URL stands for Uniform Resource Locator. It is the web address used to access websites and resources on the internet (e.g., https://www.google.com is a URL).

mockTests.title: Punjab Police Mock Test 4 — Advanced Level
mockTests.description: 20 questions with current affairs (2025-2026) and advanced reasoning. Highest difficulty.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.q: Who is the current Director General of Punjab Police (2026)?
questions.exp: Gaurav Yadav is the Director General of Police (DGP) of Punjab as of 2026. He is a 1992-batch IPS officer who took over as Punjab's DGP in 2022.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.q: The Sutlej-Yamuna Link (SYL) canal dispute is between Punjab and which state?
questions.exp: The SYL canal dispute is a long-standing water dispute between Punjab and Haryana. After Punjab's reorganization in 1966, the water of Ravi and Beas rivers was to be shared. The SYL canal was meant to carry Haryana's share but Punjab has opposed its construction.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.q: Under which article of the Indian Constitution can the President of India declare a National Emergency?
questions.exp: Article 352 empowers the President to declare a National Emergency on grounds of war, external aggression, or armed rebellion. Article 356 deals with State Emergency (President's Rule) and Article 360 with Financial Emergency.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.q: The 'Mission Indradhanush' programme of the Government of India is related to:
questions.exp: Mission Indradhanush (launched 2014) aims to immunize all children under 2 years and pregnant women against 12 vaccine-preventable diseases. 'Indradhanush' means rainbow, representing the 7+ vaccines used.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.q: Which Sikh Guru founded the city of Amritsar?
questions.exp: Guru Ram Das Ji (4th Sikh Guru) founded the city of Amritsar in 1574. He started the excavation of the holy sarovar (pond). His son Guru Arjan Dev Ji later built the Harmandir Sahib (Golden Temple) in the centre of the sarovar.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.q: India's first female DGP belongs to which state?
questions.exp: Punjab appointed India's first female Director General of Police. Kanchan Chaudhary Bhattacharya of Uttarakhand Police was actually India's first female DGP in 2006 — this is a commonly misquoted fact in exams. Verify against your specific exam notification.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.q: The International Border (IB) between India and Pakistan in Punjab is called:
questions.exp: The International Border between India and Pakistan was demarcated by Sir Cyril Radcliffe in 1947 and is called the Radcliffe Line. The Line of Control (LOC) is the de facto border in Jammu & Kashmir. Durand Line is between Pakistan and Afghanistan.

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.q: The LCM of 12, 18 and 24 is:

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.q: Two pipes A and B can fill a tank in 12 and 16 hours respectively. If both pipes are opened together, in how many hours will the tank be filled?
questions.exp: Combined rate = 1/12 + 1/16 = 4/48 + 3/48 = 7/48. Time = 48/7 = 6.86 hours (≈ 6 hours 51 minutes).

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.q: The marked price of a shirt is ₹800. After a 10% discount, what is the selling price?

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.q: If the circumference of a circle is 44 cm, what is its area? (Use π = 22/7)

questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude
questions.q: A man walks at 5 km/h and covers a distance in 2 hours. If he had walked at 4 km/h, how much extra time would he have taken?
questions.exp: Distance = 5×2 = 10 km. Time at 4 km/h = 10/4 = 2.5 hours. Extra time = 2.5 - 2 = 0.5 hours = 30 minutes.

questions.subject: Mental Ability & Reasoning
questions.q: Arrange in logical order: (1) Arrest (2) Crime (3) Judgment (4) Trial (5) Punishment
questions.exp: The logical sequence is: Crime (2) happens first → Arrest (1) follows → Trial (4) is conducted → Judgment (3) is given → Punishment (5) is awarded. So 2,1,4,3,5.

questions.subject: Mental Ability & Reasoning
questions.q: In a certain code, 'Punjab' is written as 'QVOKCB'. How is 'POLICE' written in that code?
questions.exp: Each letter is shifted one position forward: P→Q, U→V, N→O, J→K, A→B, B→C. Similarly: P→Q, O→P, L→M, I→J, C→D, E→F = QPMJDF.

questions.subject: Mental Ability & Reasoning
questions.q: Six people are sitting in a circle facing the centre. A is between F and B. D is between E and C. F and C are opposite each other. Who is opposite to A?
questions.exp: Placing in a circle: F-A-B on one side. F and C are opposite, so C is opposite F. D is between E and C. The arrangement is F,A,B,C,D,E (or similar). A is opposite to D.

questions.subject: Mental Ability & Reasoning
questions.q: Find the missing term: ACE, BDF, CEG, ___
questions.exp: Pattern: Each set of 3 letters starts one position after previous first letter and continues with alternating letters. A,C,E → B,D,F → C,E,G → D,F,H. Each sequence starts with consecutive letters (A,B,C,D) and skips one (A+2, A+4).

questions.subject: English Language
questions.q: Identify the error: 'Each of the students (A) / have submitted (B) / their assignment (C) / on time. (D)'
questions.exp: 'Each of the students' takes a singular verb. 'Have submitted' should be 'has submitted'. Rule: Each, Every, Either, Neither → singular verb. Correct: 'Each of the students has submitted their assignment on time.'

questions.subject: English Language
questions.q: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom 'To burn the midnight oil':
opts: To work late into the night
questions.exp: 'To burn the midnight oil' means to work or study late into the night. It comes from the time when people literally used oil lamps, burning oil at midnight to work late.

questions.subject: Digital Literacy
questions.q: In MS Excel, which function is used to find the highest value in a range of cells?
questions.exp: MAX() function in MS Excel returns the maximum (highest) value from a range of cells. For example, =MAX(A1:A10) returns the highest value in cells A1 through A10. MIN() gives the minimum value.

questions.subject: Digital Literacy
questions.q: What is 'Phishing' in cybersecurity?
opts: Fraudulent attempt to steal sensitive info by impersonating trusted entities
questions.exp: Phishing is a cybercrime where attackers disguise themselves as trusted entities (banks, govt websites) to trick users into revealing passwords, credit card numbers, or OTPs. It is one of the most common cyber threats tested in government exams.
